scope: drive the legal phase-3 connection state machine through the loopback ring and enumerate what the client sends at each phase

sequence.action: ring_bridge start-challenge: cl+0x14 = loopback netadr (type 2, ip 0, port 0, channel 0x9D), [0x76446B0]=3

sequence.note: the client emits getchallenge every frame while phase 3; ring A reached 12/12 within a few seconds
empty statsResponse does not advance; the client keeps re-sending stats every frame

conclusions: the legal phase-3 path works end to end through the in-process loopback ring: 0x5C05F0 emits getchallenge, the client accepts the OOB challengeResponse and advances to phase 4, then emits a full connect request, and accepts an empty connectResponse to reach CS_PRIMED (phase 5)
the earlier conclusion that 0x5C05F0 exits before sending was an artefact of the previous setup; with a clean rebuilt cl and a loopback netadr the send path is fully functional
at phase 5 the client uploads a 1251-byte stats blob and a short 52-byte stats packet every frame; an empty statsResponse is ignored

the next gate is the stats/gamestate exchange: either a correctly formatted statsResponse or a minimal gamestate (configstrings and entity baseline) is required to reach CS_ACTIVE and the loading screen
